schema_name: GitHub Hosted Soulbound Token Record Schema

field_definitions.object_id: Unique machine-readable identifier for the SBT record.
field_definitions.object_type: Type of object. Expected value: soulbound_token_record.
field_definitions.status: Current status of the record, such as active, archived, revoked, or superseded.
field_definitions.transferability: Whether the record can be transferred. For SBTs, this should be false.
field_definitions.subject: The person, organization, or entity represented by the SBT.
field_definitions.issuer: The person, organization, or system that created the record.
field_definitions.claims: Array of identity, education, professional, award, publication, or service claims.
field_definitions.ai_retrieval_policy: Rules for AI systems retrieving or using the record.
field_definitions.provenance: Information about source materials and origin of the record.
field_definitions.last_updated: Date the record was last updated.

claim_fields.claim_type: Category of claim, such as education, professional_role, honor_award, publication, or domain_expertise.
claim_fields.evidence: Pointer to evidence supporting the claim.
claim_fields.verification_level: Level of verification, such as self_attested, resume_attested, institution_verified, public_record_verified, or cryptographically_signed.
